senses.gloss: m.(b. h. כֹּתֶל; כתל to press together, [something solid, cmp. אָטוּם, אוֹטֶם,] wall.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 68:10">Gen. R. s. 68</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 28:11">Gen. XXVIII, 11</cite> ‘he struck’) <he>נעשה … כמין כ׳ וכ׳</he> the whole world was before him blocked as by a wall. Ohol. VI, 3 <he>כ׳ שהוא לאויר</he> a wall which faces the air (which is continued above the roofing, or faces the court yard). Ib. <he>כ׳ המשמש את הבית</he> a wall made for forming an enclosure, contrad. to ib. 6 <he>בית המשמש את הכ׳</he> a wall formed by digging two cavities next to each other.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 1:1">B. Bath. I, 1</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>כּוֹתָלִים</he>, <he>כּוֹתָלִין</he>, <he>כְּתָלִ׳</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 4:2:5">Y. Shek. IV, 48ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>כתלין</he> (Bab. ed. <he>כתלים</he>, Ms. M. <cite ref="K00428"><he>כותל</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 18">Gen. R. s. 18</cite>, beg. <he>כ׳ של זהב</he> golden partitions (of Adam’s tent).
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 59b:3">B. Mets. 59ᵇ</cite> <he>כּוֹתְלֵי בה״מ וכ׳</he> let the walls of the school house decide.
<cite ref="Niddah 3a:44">Nidd. 3ᵃ</cite> <he>כותלי בית הרחם</he> the enclosures of the womb; a. fr.
